input.subject: Invoice query – Washing Machine Repair, Flat 20, 120 Alder Lane, Cedarford ZZ9 0ZZ (Ref R/PM042-2 / NBL-042)
input.body:
Dear Lantern Services,

Thank you for your email regarding your invoice of £75.11 for the washing machine repair at Flat 20, 120 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ9 0ZZ (our ref R/PM042-2 / NBL-042).

Before we can process it, we need to match it to the work. Our records do not show a visit report, and our most recent note (27 February) is a call asking for a callback to schedule the visit. Could you please reply with:
- the date the engineer attended, and what was found and done (including whether the machine now heats on 60°C cycles, or whether further parts/repair are needed and at what cost);
- a copy of the invoice itself (PDF) showing the property address and our reference, as we cannot see the document from the online link.

Please do not carry out any further chargeable work beyond the original inspection without our written approval.

Kind regards,
Maintenance Team

data.reasoning:
The auto classification seems off here - the invoice for £75.11 conflicts with the latest record showing the contractor still trying to schedule the visit, with no completion report or approved amount. This could just be a callout or diagnostic fee, so a proportionate step would be asking the contractor to confirm whether the visit happened, what was found, and to send the actual invoice for review.
